subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting runtime object utilities: singly-linked-list containers with node ownership flags and their search, sort, removal, indexed-access and destruction operations; career and season scoring state; scene filter properties; team identity and short-string fields; camera FOV state; and global singleton/audio teardown dispatch.

summary: Proposed grouping of generic runtime objects in the 0x4C0000 block: a family of singly-linked-list containers that share a node layout (data pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, ownership/flag byte at +8) but differ in container field placement (heads at this+0x0, this+0x8, this+0x10, or behind a header pointer at this+0xC), plus career/season scoring state, team identity fields, scene filter properties, camera FOV interpolation, and shutdown dispatch over global singletons. The list operations, node/header layouts, scoring gates and teardown contracts are the defensible, evidence-linked core; owner class identities remain mostly UNKNOWN and the heterogeneous container layouts are kept separate rather than merged.

function_roles.role: Destroys the two singly-linked lists (payloads released only for owned nodes) and zeroes the container's list words.
Deep destruction of two intrusive lists plus zeroing of the container state block; one restored value (from dword_7D0A24) and one ready byte (this+0x6C = 1) survive the clear.
Writes the career-statistics text block (headers, player/opponent states over a linked list, per-track records over a second list, separator tokens) into the output buffer context.
Walks the named-entry list and returns the node whose name string matches a2 (falling back to a default path when the node name is null).
Returns the flags of the dereferenced list node, or an unspecified register value on the null path (genuine undefined behavior in the rendered body).

Race-session scoring update gated on session type: updates short-term scoring, running average, conditionally feeds the AI difficulty value, processes the race-setup scaling factor, and increments a session counter in championship modes.

Season scoring statistics update from the player vehicle: accumulates laps into the track scene node, records minimum speed, feeds the accumulator, and in championship modes evaluates the 90%-race-distance completion criterion.
Merge-sorts the list in ascending order of the float sort key at payload+4, splitting at the midpoint and merging recursively.

Removes every node whose vehicle field fails to match all filter criteria, updating head/tail/cursor/count and freeing removed nodes (and data when the ownership flag is set); returns the remaining count.
Searches the list for a node whose data value equals the key; returns 1 on the first match and 0 otherwise.
Frees the scene-node list, freeing each node's data buffer only when the ownership flag byte is set, then zeroes the list pointer fields; returns a string-copy helper result made at entry.
Bounds-checked indexed read into the list; returns the selected node's first dword or an unspecified placeholder on any failure.
Copies the static event-name string through the validated string-copy helper and returns its result; a thin forwarding stub.
Initializes a scene-filter property (scene index, order position, slot sentinel, name) and resolves the scene's slot.
Writes the team id to five mirrored fields across the object so every sub-structure agrees on team identity; returns the value written.
Sets the 7-character short-string buffer (this+0x4708, terminated at +0x470F) and stores the derived string code at this+0x4710.
Destroys the list rooted at the header pointer this+0xC, invoking each node's content destructor when the ownership flag is set, freeing nodes and the header, and clearing the header fields.
Interpolates the camera FOV stored at this+0x8 toward a session-type/race-phase dependent target with a clamped step (min(a2*0.125, 0.05)), never overshooting the target.
Searches the list for an entry whose data word matches the global comparison value and clears the entry's match flag word at +0x18.
Teardown dispatch over four global singleton pointers via vtable slots (slot 0 with argument 1, or slot 12 with no extra argument), clearing each global after dispatch.
Stops/clears the audio mixer via vtable slot 12 on dword_8AC4C8 and deactivates the device by clearing the active flag at this+0x10.
Conditionally writes a mixer-level ratio into this+0x18 with state this+0x14 = 2, using the constant flt_7CF380 when the denominator is non-positive.

classes.name: DualListOwner
classes.responsibility: Container that owns two singly-linked lists (list A at this+0x0, list B at this+0x10) and an optional state block up to this+0x8C; provides deep cleanup that releases owned payloads and zeroes the container.

classes.name: TrackedLinkedList
classes.responsibility: Singly linked list tracked by head/tail/cursor/count fields with optional per-node ownership flags; supports filtered removal, key search, and node-list cleanup.

classes.name: FloatKeySortableList
classes.responsibility: List whose nodes wrap a payload holding a float sort key at payload+4; supports recursive merge sorting in ascending key order.

classes.name: GuardedListAccessor
classes.responsibility: Provides bounds-checked indexed access into a list: rejects negative indices, validates against an (index, count) range, bounds-checks, then walks nodes to the selected entry.

classes.name: NamedSceneList
classes.responsibility: List of named scene entries with a cursor for lookup; searches by node name string with a default-path fallback when a node name is null.

classes.name: NodeFlagsProxy
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper that dereferences a list node and returns its flags; the null path returns an unspecified register value.

classes.name: CareerStatsFileWriter
classes.responsibility: Serializes career statistics into an output buffer context: optional header, career/race-condition/game-option label lines, player/opponent states, per-track records, and closing separator.

classes.name: SeasonScoringState
classes.responsibility: Session-gated race/season scoring state: short-term scoring updates, running averages, lap accumulation, and the championship completion criterion.

classes.name: SceneFilterProperty
classes.responsibility: Record describing a scene filter: scene index, order position, slot/sort-key sentinel, and filter name; resolves the scene slot via a lookup.

classes.name: TeamIdentityObject
classes.responsibility: Large vehicle/team object that replicates the team id across five mirror fields and stores a 7-character short string plus its derived code.

classes.name: CameraState
classes.responsibility: Camera state holding a field-of-view value that is interpolated toward a session-type and race-phase dependent target.

classes.name: HeaderLinkedList
classes.responsibility: List managed through a header block (head/tail/cursor/count) pointed to by this+0xC; provides full destruction with content-destructor invocation and a global-value match search.

classes.name: GlobalSingletonRegistry
classes.responsibility: Process-global singleton registry whose teardown dispatches each non-null singleton through a vtable slot and then clears the global pointer.

classes.name: AudioMixerState
classes.responsibility: Audio mixer/device state: reset deactivates the device and dispatches a stop/clear vtable method; a conditional ratio computation stores mixer-level ratios and a state code.

classes.name: EventNameProvider
classes.responsibility: Provides the static event-name string by copying it through the validated string-copy helper; a thin forwarding stub.

transitions.via: dword_7C56A4 matches no case 3..7; FOV target 0.25
dword_7C56A4 == 5; base FOV 0.34, phase-dependent on dword_7C56A8
dword_7C56A4 == 7; base FOV 0.38, phase-dependent on dword_7C56A8
dword_7C56A8 == 5: index from sub_4D1B50(0), FOV from dword_5F0714 stride 4656, clamped to >=0.5

interfaces.name: ListSearch
interfaces.purpose: Locate nodes in singly linked lists by name, key, filter criteria, global-value match, or indexed position.

interfaces.name: ListDestruction
interfaces.purpose: Release list nodes and their owned payloads, honoring the per-node ownership flag before every free.

interfaces.name: ScoringUpdate
interfaces.purpose: Session-gated scoring and statistics updates driven by the player vehicle state.

interfaces.name: SingletonTeardown
interfaces.purpose: Dispatch teardown of process-global singleton objects through their vtables.

compatibility_contracts.name: List node layout
compatibility_contracts.description: List nodes are intrusive 12-byte entries: data/content pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, ownership/alive flag byte at +8. Node and payload deallocation must route through FreeWrapper_7bcf.

compatibility_contracts.name: List header layout
compatibility_contracts.description: Header-managed lists keep head/tail/cursor/count at header offsets +0/+4/+8/+0xC and hold the header pointer at this+0xC; after destruction the header fields are zeroed and this+0xC cleared.

compatibility_contracts.name: Ownership-flag cleanup semantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Destructors release an owned payload (via cleanup helpers such as PitStopMemoryCleanup) before freeing the node when the +8 flag is set; the node is freed in every iteration, and containers zero their list fields afterwards.

compatibility_contracts.name: Career statistics text block
compatibility_contracts.description: The career block writes a fixed header/label sequence (career totals, race conditions, game options, player/opponent states, per-track records) through the buffer writer 0x00566C30, bracketed by the separator token global 0x005C30B4.

compatibility_contracts.name: Session type and championship mode semantics
compatibility_contracts.description: dword_7C56A4 == 7 selects the race-session scoring branch; dword_7D0410 values 3 and 4 select championship mode with the 90%-race-distance completion criterion; dword_8AB6E4 == 2 gates the scoring update off.

compatibility_contracts.name: Team identity replication
compatibility_contracts.description: Writes of the team id must reach the five mirrored fields (offsets +0x4, +0x10, +0x32D0, +0x4038, +0x4894) so all sub-structures remain consistent.

compatibility_contracts.name: Camera FOV interpolation
compatibility_contracts.description: FOV moves toward a session/phase target by step min(a2*0.125, 0.05) and never overshoots; targets are clamped to [0.25, 1.0] or [0.5, 1.0] depending on the session type.

compatibility_contracts.name: Global singleton teardown dispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: At shutdown the four global singletons are dispatched via vtable slot 0 with argument 1 (dword_8AC4C8 / 8AC4CC / 8AC4D0) or vtable slot 12 with no extra argument (dword_8AC4C4), then each global is cleared to null.

unresolved: Callee 0x004C1E40 is recorded in the packet but absent from the raw source; its role is unknown.
The object type owning the two-list container (and what the payloads are) is unidentified; packet owner evidence is empty, so DualListOwner is a proposed grouping, not a confirmed class.
Purpose of the sub_4C1E20(1) third-pass side-effect in 0x004C1700 is unknown; the re-walk after both lists were freed likely merges separate source-level cleanup sites.

Container field layouts differ across the list functions (heads at this+0x0, this+0x8 or this+0x10; inline-head vs header-pointer at this+0xC); equal offsets on different this bases are kept separate rather than merged into one class.
this+0x14 is read as an (index, count) pair in 0x004C50E0, as the count in 0x004C4BB0/0x004C4CB0, and as a pointer field zeroed in 0x004C4CF0; the semantics conflict is unresolved.
dword_7D0A24 is read and restored into this+0x80, and the ready byte set at this+0x6C is the only non-zero field in the cleared block; their meanings are unknown.
Identity of the four singleton object types and the dispatched vtable methods behind 0x004C8350 is not statically known; the constant 1 (first three) vs no argument (fourth) is unexplained.
The vtable slot-12 method on dword_8AC4C8 in 0x004C8630 is read as stop/clear audio from prior analysis (DERIVED), not proven here.

The null-path return of 0x004C2990, the header-NULL early return of 0x004C7E80, and the v3 == 0 fallback of 0x004C2A80 read uninitialized register values (genuine undefined behavior in the rendered bodies).

Jump tables jpt_4C7F4B (0x004C8144) and jpt_4C8011 (0x004C8158) drive the FOV switch but are absent from the raw text; many float globals listed in the packet (flt_59E4xx, flt_5ACDxx, dword_8ACEE0) are not referenced in the visible body.

sub_588410 (string equality, 0 on match), sub_66810 (criteria match), sub_587ECE / sub_587DD0 (string code / bounded copy), ReadFieldAtOffset0x14 (0x005871F0) and BoundsCheckedIndexSetter_6760 (0x004C6760) contracts are inferred from call patterns only.
MEMORY[0] is a decompiler placeholder for the failure-path return value in 0x004C50E0; the actual value is unspecified.
Global 0x005D2B14 (aPlayertracksta) and field this+0x0C (track-stats data container) in 0x004C2420 are listed in the packet but absent from the raw body.
The node's data-buffer flag byte at node+8 in 0x004C4CF0 has no dedicated packet field evidence reference; scene/layer node identity and owner class are unknown.
The exact meaning of the +16472 vehicle state word, the +16444 lap count, and the 4/3 championship-mode enumeration in the scoring functions is not proven by this packet.
Read-only globals flt_59E440, flt_59E824 and unk_5EC6D0 in the scoring functions render as constants (0.0 / 0.89999998) and are not directly referenced in the raw body.

The 7-character short-string buffer at this+0x4708 in 0x004C69B0 is evidenced only via source:raw and callee 0x00587DD0 (no field:this:0x00004708 evidence ref exists in the packet), so it is not modeled as a class field; only its terminator (+0x470F) and derived code (+0x4710) carry field evidence.

dword_7C56A4 as session-type selector and dword_7C56A8 as race-phase selector are inferred from branch structure only; sub_4D1B50(0) returns an index into dword_5F0714 at stride 4656 whose meaning is not established.
